purpose: One bounded Copernicus/Swiss multiscale representation experiment; no production adoption or generic resolver.
heightPolicy: Preserve source heights. Copernicus EGM2008, Swiss LN02. Heterogeneous native-height representation explicitly labelled; no datum/registration correction or numerical blending.
spatialPolicy: Use actual per-level complete Swiss delivery inventory, not source rectangle centre tests. Missing regional tiles fall to common; that does not validate the delivery edge as a seamline. Protected circle is preservation intent, source support 10x10km, transition support unresolved.
scaleDiscovery: Common-only versus H0 at established landscape/planning/close/detail cameras plus z12.4,14.2,15.2; inspect actual native DEM levels, screen footprint and source differences before freezing H1 gate.

candidates.H0: Hard whole-tile regional substitution wherever an existing Swiss tile is supported (z12-18), common elsewhere.
candidates.H1: Common at native DEM levels below an empirically frozen detail gate; exact supported Swiss tiles at/above gate, common elsewhere.
candidates.H2: Optional whole-view support gate applied to H1; common stream when view footprint lacks a conservative Swiss support collar. Explicit source URL/cache revision switching, no interpolation. Test only if H1 shows boundary failure and footprint gating is useful.

delivery: One evaluation raster-dem stream per strategy; both Atlas visual geometry/relief sources use it. z8-18; common native z8-13, exact bilinear overzoom of encoded z13 heights above13. Not a global pyramid. Original products remain immutable.
provenance: Every tile gets a constant contributor label mask (0 common EGM2008,1 Swiss LN02), tile hashes, parent identity and processing. No blended cells or weights. Contribution label is not confidence.
successBeforeResults: Meaningful regional information at practical detail scale
Exact Swiss delivery values within protected interior when regional representation is selected
Common remains unchanged outside regional delivery support apart from documented overzoom quantization
No false walls in supported navigation
No arbitrary broad smoothing or unexplained height correction
Explainable scale transitions with recoverable contributors
boundedStopping: Test H0 and H1, at most one H2 support-gate control if justified. If seams or popping remain, retain negative result; no widening collars, new fusion algorithms, acquisition or generic resolver.
scope: No AWS/analytical/Weather/Traverse/IGOR/exaggeration/satellite/projection/lifecycle change. No Swiss transformation, imagery, global coverage or private estate. Large generated outputs outside Git.
